items.statement: In published evaluations, one-hour rule-out keeps 30-day death or myocardial infarction among ruled-out patients below 0.5 percent, but rules out fewer than a third of patients aged 75 or over.
items.rationale: The committee needs both halves: safety and the realistic yield for this unit's older case mix; both can be extracted within six weeks.
items.risks: Few studies report age-specific yield; kidney function definitions differ.

items.statement: Timed phlebotomy prompts reduce second-sample timing failures to below 10 percent.
items.rationale: One evaluation reported a fall from 22 to 9 percent after a prompt; the review can check whether others agree.

summary: Two hypotheses; h1 selected as the committee's central question.
